verdict.rationale: Summarizing missed channels and threads is a fair question for a team chat product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only topics, channels, search filters and a custom-bot framework, with no first-party AI summary or recap feature. The bot framework is a developer building block a team could use to build summaries, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed
